conventions.candidate_names: Every proposed event family and variable name is a CANDIDATE pending event-schema/scoring-plan rulings; nothing in this file promotes a name.
conventions.authority_level_separation: Four statuses are tracked separately and must never be conflated. (1) authorised_design: whether the research owner has approved the measurement design. (2) implementation_status: whether anything exists in the tree. (3) canonical_event_status: whether canonical production event and payload names exist (event-schema, tier 3). (4) scoring_status: whether an approved variable, weight, threshold, formula or composite exists (scoring-plan, tier 4). As of 2026-07-30 every ruling recorded here is authorised_design only: nothing is implemented, no canonical event name is approved, and no formula is approved.
conventions.exploratory_analogue_rule: Where an adopted ruling authorises a module for a questionnaire-primary item (Q32, Q33), any eventual indicator is an exploratory short-session analogue only. It is never a validated item score and never a replacement for the Qualtrics questionnaire item.
conventions.shared_construct_exception: Q29/Q31 goal-horizon is the only authorised shared-construct exception (global ruling section 2). Authorising a dedicated module for another item is never a permission to reuse another item's primary evidence.
conventions.contamination_default: Per ruling section 9: a contaminated or absent opportunity is missing/invalid measurement, never behavioural non-performance, and is never assigned a low trait score. Raw data must record opportunity id, order/counterbalance condition, entry-state validity, prior module exposure, technical/comprehension failure, and a contamination flag.
conventions.shared_context_default: Room entry/exit, movement, scenario_* pilot telemetry, dock control covariates, hub navigation and DEV-probe traffic are permissible shared context and must remain unscored for every item.
conventions.implementation_status_note: authorised_design_not_implemented was added 2026-07-30: the measurement design is approved by the research owner and the module is NOT built; canonical events and scoring remain pending. It never means implemented.
